description: Adapts already corrected OpenXR angular velocity to Steam Link 2.0.23's local controller axes. Requires the active Galaxy XR OpenXR Velocity Frame runtime module; do not use with stock runtime velocities or old HAL/velocity/extrapolation APK layers. Changes angular velocity only, not poses, linear velocity or prediction. Exact 2.0.23/5002363 only; headset A/B validation pending. Controller tracking and haptics based on @4uva4ek's Galaxy XR modules: https://github.com/4uva4ek.
name: Controller angular world to local

description: Routes controller vibration to the grip vibrator instead of the trigger, which Galaxy XR uses for every OpenXR vibration. The grip one needs shell rights, so this needs Shizuku running with its permission granted to Steam Link; without it vibration is stock. Controller tracking and haptics based on @4uva4ek's Galaxy XR modules: https://github.com/4uva4ek.
name: Controller grip haptics through Shizuku

description: Makes the Galaxy XR runtime extrapolate controller poses to the time VRLink asks, instead of repeating one sample per display frame, and filters jitter out of the streamed pose. Adds an OpenXR API layer; no Steam Link code changes. Controller tracking and haptics based on @4uva4ek's Galaxy XR modules: https://github.com/4uva4ek.
name: Controller pose extrapolation

description: Takes controller poses straight from the Galaxy XR controller HAL instead of the OpenXR runtime, removing the runtime's ~35 ms sample lag, and filters jitter out of pose and velocity. The HAL needs shell rights, so this needs Shizuku running with its permission granted to Steam Link; without Shizuku tracking stays as it is. Steam Link 2.0.23: angular velocity is reported local to the grip pose. Steam Link 2.0.20 - 2.0.22: angular velocity is reported in the base space. Controller tracking and haptics based on @4uva4ek's Galaxy XR modules: https://github.com/4uva4ek.
name: Controller tracking from the controller HAL through Shizuku

description: Rotates the controller velocities the Galaxy XR runtime reports into the frames SteamVR reads, so thrown objects leave in the right direction. Stock, they arrive in a controller-attached frame. Adds an OpenXR API layer; no Steam Link code is changed. Steam Link 2.0.23: angular velocity is reported local to the streamed pose. Steam Link 2.0.20 - 2.0.22: angular velocity is reported in the base space. Controller tracking and haptics based on @4uva4ek's Galaxy XR modules: https://github.com/4uva4ek.
name: Controller velocity frame

Three guarded bytes in libvr4p-oculus.so; runtime application pending headset validation. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
name: Galaxy XR refresh profile (72 Hz, 4XVR)

description: Installs the Galaxy XR face transport for the VRCFT module, per exact build: the face-tracking bridge layer (XR_FB_face_tracking2 to XR_ANDROID_face_tracking) and the FACE_TRACKING permission on the legacy targets 5001712/5001812/5001968/5002244; the tongue out/left/right/up/down transport slots (keeping Valve's native face expressions and standard TongueOut) on 2.0.23/5002363.

description: Installs the modified libplacebo 7.360.1 (LGPL-2.1-or-later), the 4XVR HDR bridge native and the bundled open-source notices for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
name: HDR pipeline payload (4XVR)

description: Loads the HDR bridge, routes the decoder output surface through it for the FP16 hand-off, detects HLG from the video MediaFormat and keeps the bridge informed of movie/seek transitions for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Headset validation pending. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
name: libplacebo HDR pipeline (4XVR)

description: Stubs the 11 exported Oculus platform-init/entitlement/message functions in libovrplatformloader.so of exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. The reference Galaxy XR build requires the Meta platform channel to stay inert on a non-Meta runtime: without these stubs the app hangs on the splash — the OpenXR session is created but never presents its first frame (Galaxy XR on-device A/B, 2026-10-12). Meta-store VIP flows degrade. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
name: Meta platform decoupling (4XVR)

options.title: Microphone mode

description: Applies OLED gamma/saturation calibration with 8-bit sRGB output, plus optional VD-like SDR foveal processing and a separate foveal gamma. Exact builds 5001712, 5001812, 5001968, 5002244, 5002363; visible improvement needs headset verification.
name: OLED color calibration

options.description: Selects gamma and saturation for both layers when the VD options are off, or for the base layer when a VD foveal option is on.
options.title: Calibration profile

options.description: Used by Custom profile. Allowed range: 0.50 to 2.50.
options.title: Gamma

options.description: Used by Custom profile. Allowed range: 0.00 to 3.00.
options.title: Saturation

options.description: VD-informed SDR processing for declared 10-bit input: use highp sampling, retain Valve's decoder colour correction, bypass the calibration profile on the foveal layer, and add no shader noise. The separate foveal gamma adjustment still applies. Output is 8-bit sRGB. Does not negotiate host depth or reproduce VD's raw-YUV decoder import. Mutually exclusive with the 8-bit option and separate blue-noise patch.
options.title: Fovea VD-Like Input 10 bit

options.description: Uses the same VD-informed SDR foveal processing for declared 8-bit input, retaining Valve's decoder colour correction while bypassing the calibration profile and adding no shader noise. The separate foveal gamma adjustment still applies. Output is 8-bit sRGB. Cannot recover precision already lost in the source. Mutually exclusive with the 10-bit option and separate blue-noise patch; does not negotiate host depth.
options.title: Fovea VD-Like Input 8 bit

options.description: Additional gamma on the foveal layer only, after its colour processing. 1.00 leaves it unchanged; higher values darken shadows and midtones. Try 1.02 first for a lighter foveal region. Works with either VD option or both off, before fade and optional blue-noise dithering. Background calibration and edge blending stay unchanged; this is manual compensation, not a verified seam fix.
options.title: Foveal gamma adjustment
